title: DigiWal - Engineering
description: Flows, Sweeper, Reaper, Hot wallet, performance and the auditor's findings.

options.content: Operator view. Each row is one area; the **Auditor** row is the first thing to look at. Numbers marked *(process)* restart with the service. *Not here yet:* gas and Fee Bump panels (next change), request-to-credit latency, RPC latency and Kafka consumer lag (no service exports them).

panels.title: Alerts firing or pending
panels.description: Prometheus alerts from infra/prometheus/alerts.yml. Empty is good.

panels.title: Critical suspicious open
panels.description: Should be 0.

panels.title: Warnings open
panels.description: Warnings that are not critical yet (lag, drift within tolerance).

panels.title: Oldest open critical
panels.description: How long the oldest critical finding has been open.

panels.title: New suspicious transactions per day
panels.description: Findings recorded each day (rows are never deleted, so this only counts new ones).

panels.title: Open by flow and rule
panels.description: Open suspicious transactions: W = withdrawals, D = deposits, L = ledger, T = treasury and Hot signing, C = reconciliation.

panels.title: Periodic checks
panels.description: One line per audit job. Last run and last success are kept apart: an error is never a success. A job with no run for 3 intervals is stale (an alert).

panels.title: Open suspicious transactions
panels.description: Read from the auditor's own database (read-only login). `reference` names the withdrawal, the transfer or the check; `detail` has both sides of the mismatch.

targets.rawSql: SELECT detected_at, severity, status, flow, rule, reference, detail->>'problem' AS problem FROM suspicious_transactions WHERE status IN ('open','acknowledged') ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'warn' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, detected_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Reconciliation: residual per asset
panels.description: On-chain custody minus what the ledger accounts for. Should sit at 0; a flat non-zero line within tolerance is the accepted gas drift.

panels.title: Reconciliation: on chain vs ledger
panels.description: The three figures behind the residual.

panels.title: Recent reconciliation runs
panels.description: Amounts in minor units (a residual of 5 at 6 decimals is 0.000005).

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at, symbol, block_number, residual, tolerance FROM recon_snapshots ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Deposits credited per minute
panels.description: Rate over 5 minutes.

panels.title: chain-watcher: head vs watermark
panels.description: The head is read by its own ticker, so a stuck poll loop shows as a growing gap, not as two flat lines.

panels.title: Blocks behind
panels.description: Lag in blocks, and the confirmation depth that is its expected floor. The alert fires above depth + 20.

panels.title: Head read age
panels.description: Seconds since the head was last read from the RPC. Rising means the RPC is unreachable.

panels.title: Flagged deposits pending
panels.description: Deposits held for a Screening List sender, waiting for review.

panels.title: Failed events
panels.description: Events ledger-service could not process and parked. Should be 0.

panels.title: Active Locks
panels.description: Withdrawal amounts reserved right now, and the age of the oldest.

panels.title: Transitions per minute, by stage (process)
panels.description: How many requests moved out of each status per minute.

panels.title: Time in each status, p50 and p95 (process)
panels.description: How long a request spent in a status before leaving it. broadcast_to_confirmed is the wait for the chain.

panels.title: Failures by reason (1 h)
panels.description: failed and rejected requests by the reason recorded.

panels.title: Requests by status now
panels.description: Current number of requests in each status.

panels.title: Oldest request per status
panels.description: Age of the oldest request in each non-terminal status.

panels.title: Outbox backlog and oldest event
panels.description: Events written with a state change and not yet acknowledged by Kafka. Target: oldest under 30 s.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Gas Top-Ups and Sweeps sent and not yet mined.

panels.title: Oldest in flight
panels.description: Age of the oldest one. Target: under 10 minutes.

panels.title: Completion time p95
panels.description: Sent to mined, successful ones.

panels.title: Fee Bumps and ALERTs (1 h)
panels.description: Fee Bumps of stuck Gas Top-Ups and ALERTs raised.

panels.title: Last pass
panels.description: Seconds since the Reaper last finished a pass. Over 150 s fires ReaperDead.

panels.title: Stuck requests by status
panels.description: Past the Reaper's own timeout. reserved, signed and broadcast stay until an operator acts.

panels.title: Reaper actions (1 h, process)
panels.description: Stuck requests the Reaper failed, by reason.

panels.title: ALERTs by kind (1 h, process)
panels.description: ALERTs raised for an operator (after de-duplication).

panels.title: Hot wallet vs Floor and Ceiling
panels.description: On-chain Hot balance with the Asset Registry's Floor (red) and Ceiling (orange). The lines move when the registry is edited and the service restarted.

panels.title: Warm and Cold
panels.description: On-chain balance of the reserve and long-term wallets. No limits are defined for them.

panels.title: Hot position in its band
panels.description: 0% = at the Floor, 100% = at the Ceiling.

panels.title: Signing frozen
panels.description: 1 = a Nonce Gap froze Hot Wallet signing (wallet-service's own flag). Should be 0.

panels.title: Time since the last Hot rebalance
panels.description: From the treasury scan of the auditor's database.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() - max(block_time) AS since_last_rebalance, max(block_time) AS at FROM treasury_movements WHERE kind IN ('hot_to_warm', 'warm_to_hot')

panels.title: Treasury movements
panels.description: Every transfer with Hot, Warm or Cold on one side, found by scanning the chain. `unexplained` = value left Hot without a signature (critical). amount is in minor units; asset is the registry id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT block_time, kind, asset, amount, from_tier, to_tier, tx_hash FROM treasury_movements ORDER BY block_time DESC, block_number DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Requests per second, by service
panels.description: Health checks excluded.

panels.title: Latency p50
panels.description: Server-side. Target: 50 ms.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: Target: 200 ms.

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: Target: 2 s.

panels.title: 5xx rate
panels.description: Share of requests that fail with a 5xx. Target: under 0.1%.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: Which endpoint the latency belongs to.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, route, le) (rate(digiwal_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!~".*/healthz"}[15m]))))

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Acquired connections over the pool's maximum. Target: under 80%.

panels.title: Go runtime
panels.description: Goroutines and resident memory per service.
